audit.whatIsWrong: The page has no mechanical content about Zaahen at all — every reference is the placeholder word 'Ultimate' ('Track Ultimate', 'Zaahen wastes Ultimate', 'His big cooldown'). Three real, decisive mechanics are absent: his passive revive, his 850-range pull, and the fact that both his Q and his R heal him.
audit.why: From the kit: Determination stacks from attacks and abilities on champions give bonus AD, and at full stacks he gains increased AD and can revive. W stabs at 850 range and pulls you toward him — that is the combo opener a Maokai must respect. Q (10s at rank 1) slashes twice, heals, and its recast knocks up. E (10s) is a dash that deals percent-health damage, so stacking HP alone does not answer it. R is 110/95/80s and heals for a portion of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: Cooldown and self-heal added to dosFull[0].d, the pull to dontsFull[0].d, the revive to dontsFull[1].d, the ult's healing to whys[4], and anti-heal into the itemization line.
sources: brief enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text and cooldowns
